usedFor: Shopify holds your products, and Conversion makes an image from a prompt through “Generate Image from text prompt”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Generate Image from text prompt” in Conversion
bestTemplate.why: A new product may need extra visuals, so the action draws one from a written prompt.

watchOut: “Generate Image from text prompt” needs a written prompt, so map the product's details into it.
